description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Moritte of the Frost.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Moritte of the Frost by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.name: Moritte of the Frost
uses.cardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater
